question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Garrulous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"garrulous"** means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. (बातूनी)

 
 
• **Example: **The **garrulous** old man spent hours telling stories about his youth.
 
 
 
• **"Talkative" **refers to a person who talks a lot or enjoys having conversations. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example: **She was so** talkative** that she could keep a conversation going for hours without stopping.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'garrulous' **is **'talkative'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reserved **(आरक्षित): Slow to reveal emotion or opinions.

 
 
• **Example:** He was reserved, rarely sharing his thoughts or feelings with others.
 
 
 
• **Genuine **(सच्चा ): Truly what something is said to be; authentic.
 
 
• **Example: **She gave a genuine smile that lit up the room.
 
 
 
• **Guarded** (संरक्षित): Cautious and having reservations.
 
 
• **Example:** He was guarded in his responses, not wanting to reveal too much.
